215-955-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-955-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4153-5641-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
4153-5641-7804.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

4186-7399-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-7399-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-3259-4742.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

985-2113-3459-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1061-4359-4603.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-4359-4603.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-4359-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

643-4050-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.
643-4050-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

3028-5702-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3028-5702-6441.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Vital Force
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

141-2438-3440.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

454-1978-5704.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
454-1978-5704.description:
Cause Leafkin Avenger to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Leafkin Avenger.
Repeat from step 2.

3392-5220-6900.manaNeeded: {W} if Children of Korlis is in your hand
3392-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater if Children of Korlis is on top of your library.
3392-5220-6900.description:
Cast Children of Korlis either from your hand by paying {W} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Activate Children of Korlis by sacrificing it.
When Children of Korlis dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Children of Korlis from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Children of Korlis ability, causing you to gain life equal to the life you've lost this turn.
Repeat.

3330-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
3330-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

1789-4452-5649-6797.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-5641-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-5641-6719.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

2794-4613-4968.description:
Activate Trelasarra by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Trelasarra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness

1084-2335-3143-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1084-2335-3143-4613.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Xavier Sal using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

549-2034-5346-6520.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more opponents.
549-2034-5346-6520.notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
549-2034-5346-6520.description:
Declare two creatures you control as attackers, attacking two different opponents.
Holding priority, activate Nemesis Phoenix by paying {2}{R}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nemesis Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Nemesis Phoenix dies, Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

3094-4404-4659-6347.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Smile at Death triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Corridor Monitor, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Smile at Death's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Smile at Death's trigger, returning Corridor Monitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.
3094-4404-4659-6347.notes: You may return another creature with power 2 or less each loop to get infinite colorless mana.

2292-4336-5220-5683.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Kobolds of Kher Keep and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

190-389-3778-6035.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 5 or less.
190-389-3778-6035.description:
Cast Courageous Resolve by paying {2}{W}.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Courageous Resolve.
Cast Austere Command by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

2178-2857-3967.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Adarkar Valkyrie.
2178-2857-3967.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness. You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
2178-2857-3967.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Resolve the second trigger, returning the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

955-1170-1328-2105.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
955-1170-1328-2105.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

1365-2744-4050-4404.notablePrerequisites: Corridor Monitor does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2744-4050-4404.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Corridor Monitor, adding one mana of any color.
When Corridor Monitor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

3362-4881.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Bladewing the Risen.
3362-4881.description:
Kill Bladewing.
Cast Activated Sleeper by paying {2}{B}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard from the battlefield due to the legend rule.
Bladewing enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

2626-4487-4986.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Phyrexian Marauder enters and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

541-2104-3632-3634.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
In response, activate Erratic Portal by tapping it and paying {1}, returning Venser to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
